none: PAS NLM-A6A082: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Trier mint. Obverse description: Constantinopolis helmeted mantled with sceptre, left. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victrory standing left on prow holding sceptre and leaning on shield. In exergue: TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 2.03gms, die axis: 12
